abstract: OBJECTIVES: We present our series of residual retroperitoneal mass surgery after chemotherapy. We evaluate possible preoperative parameters that can predict the retroperitoneal mass histology. Survival and relapse rates were also evaluated. METHODS: We reviewed sixty resections of residual retroperitoneal masses of testicular tumours after chemotherapy performed at our department between 1995 and 2007. We evaluate the relationship between histology of the retroperitoneal mass and possible risk factors, such as outcomes after chemotherapy, which was evaluated as changes in the size of the retroperitoneal mass, and negativization of serum tumor markers. We also evaluate histology and size of the primary testicular cancer. RESULTS: The histology of retroperitoneal mass was necrosis or fibrosis in 25 (42%) cases, teratoma in 29 (48%) and viable tumor in 6 (10%). The size of the retroperitoneal mass decreased after the chemotherapy in 62% cases; moreover negative serum tumor markers were found in 87%. Elevated values of human chorionic gonadotropin were associated with viable cells in the retroperitoneal mass (p=0.014) and, the presence of teratoma in the primary tumor may be associated with teratoma in the retroperitoneal mass histology (p=0.002). However, no other preoperative factors that predict the residual mass histology were found. Repeated resections of retroperitoneal masses were required in four patients and 9 patients died during follow-up. CONCLUSIONS: We cannot determine preoperative parameters that accurately predict the histology of retroperitoneal masses. Therefore, resection of residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy in non-seminomatous germ cell tumours must be performed.
abstract_ja: 目的：化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤手術の症例シリーズを提示する。後腹膜腫瘤の組織像を予測しうる術前因子を評価する。生存率と再発率も評価した。方法：1995年から2007年に当科で化学療法後に精巣腫瘍の後腹膜残存腫瘤を切除した60例を後方視的に検討した。後腹膜腫瘤の組織像と、化学療法後の腫瘤サイズの変化、血清腫瘍マーカーの陰性化などのリスク因子との関係を評価した。原発精巣がんの組織像とサイズも評価した。結果：後腹膜腫瘤の組織像は、壊死または線維化が25例(42%)、奇形腫が29例(48%)、生存腫瘍が6例(10%)であった。化学療法後に後腹膜腫瘤のサイズが縮小したのは62%、血清腫瘍マーカーの陰性化は87%であった。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値は後腹膜腫瘤内の生存細胞と関連し(p=0.014)、原発腫瘍内の奇形腫の存在は後腹膜腫瘤の奇形腫と関連する可能性があった(p=0.002)。しかし、残存腫瘤の組織像を予測する他の術前因子は認められなかった。4例で再切除が必要であった。9例がフォローアップ中に死亡した。結論：後腹膜残存腫瘤の組織像を正確に予測できる術前因子は特定できなかった。したがって、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘤の切除は必須である。
